title: Normalized coefficient units in the finite-Tor domains
statement: Fix a finite-field/coefficient purity setting $P$, put $s=\operatorname{Spec}(P.field.k)$, and let $W$ be a separated finite-type scheme over this field and $S$ its stipulated six-functor datum. Use [def-pod-smooth-orientation-coefficient-family], [def-fix-six-functor-datum], [thm-coef-finite-hom], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] and [cor-pur-adic-and-rational-smooth-dualizing-complexes]. Define the coefficient unit in the existing intrinsic finite-Tor category by transporting the ordinary etale finite-Tor unit along the published finite-coefficient site comparison and its exact-derived composition isomorphism. Define the fixed six-functor datum's unit in that same category using its finiteUnit normalization and the canonical degree-zero coefficient-unit realization. Define the integral unit as the recorded completed degree-zero coefficient line integralTwist at the point. Identify the pullback-twist-shift source of the integral unit with the shifted Tate line using the recorded completed-unit pullback core and the exact twist tensor unitor. These constructors retain the actual underlying coefficient objects and supply their existing membership witnesses; they introduce no alternative unit or finiteness predicate. The underlying constructions are those of [def-pur-unit-trace-reduction-data], [lem-pur-completed-unit-pullback-tower], [lem-coef-finite-hom-site-descent].

reviewed_lean.note: 7th delivery addresses the earlier RETURNs. Statement, proof and proof_deps unchanged; only lean and stmt_deps added. Each node's lean.statement is verbatim in its file. Forward and inverse squares stated for finite, integral reduction, integral extension, rationalization, rational extension and common stage, with the canonical source maps and the q-mates b. Explicit exchange equation TY.map e ≫ R_Q = δ_{Q,C} ≫ D_s(u_Q⁻¹) ≫ e' for site-perfect K at every transition, with admissibility as hypotheses; e pinned by StageConclusion.components. Oriented square: θ=homX.map(𝟙,γ⁻¹), c_H and R_Q^H explicit, three step-6 equations. ∃Package/∃StageScalar accepted: q and unit pinned, FieldComparison.b determined by q, free tensor/pull harmless (exchangeNaturality holds for all b; transport reduces to the inverse purity square); same interface as the landed fix-cor-verdier-exchange. Edge cases d=0, m=n, exponent 1, Q̄_ℓ via the closed/common stages, nonproper X all covered.
